aiParsing.intro: When a message doesn't match a strict command (e.g. "voce tem estoque do cha de limao?"), the connected AI provider classifies it into stock/price/expiry/info and extracts the product — never a free-form chat reply, only strict classification.
aiParsing.noProvider: No enabled AI provider yet. Add one (or switch one on) under Settings → Integrations → AI first.
aiParsing.title: WhatsApp AI-assisted parsing

bol.configurationHint: Sent on every offer this connection pushes to Bol.
bol.connectIntro: Paste the credentials from your Bol.com Retailer API portal. No redirect step -- Bol authenticates via client_credentials.
bol.noOperators: Bol returned no economic operators for this account -- enter the id manually.
bol.operatorIdHint: Your EU operator identifier, required on every offer.
bol.operatorUuidHint: A UUID from Bol's Partner Platform (GPSR/economic operator settings) -- not your KVK/VAT number.
bol.ordersHint: Import only -- CommerceOS never pushes orders back to Bol. Polls currently open orders every run.
bol.scheduleIntro: Configure how often each type of data syncs between CommerceOS and Bol.com. Products/stock only push what's enrolled in your Bol sales channel -- configure enrollment under Sales Channels.
bol.stockHint: Re-pushes every already-linked product's current price and stock -- Bol has no stock-only endpoint, so this runs the same push as Products, just on its own interval.
bol.shippingCostPerParcelHint: What sending one Bol parcel costs you. Bol prices without a custom price include it, so you still earn the shop price.

card.testModeOn: Test mode on — all messages go to {{phone}}

credentials.keepKey: Leave blank to keep the current key
credentials.keyHint: Never shown once saved -- leave blank unless you're rotating it.
credentials.title: WhatsApp credentials

deleteImported.title: Delete imported products
deleteImported.warning: This permanently deletes every product imported from {{store}} — including their variants, SKUs, stock history, and images. Categories left empty afterward are also deleted. This cannot be undone.

email.noAuthHint: Leave username/password blank for a relay that needs no auth.

fallback.abandonAllMessage: They stay in the audit trail, but no retry is attempted.
fallback.empty: Nothing pending -- every webhook has been delivered.
fallback.intro: Webhooks that couldn't reach the processing queue after 3 attempts -- saved here instead of lost. Retry re-attempts delivery now; Abandon discards it (kept for audit, not deleted).
fallback.title: Undelivered webhooks

import.intro: Imports every WooCommerce product not yet linked, along with its category. Existing categories are matched by name; missing ones are created.
import.started: Import started — it's running in the background. You'll see a notification when it's done (check the bell icon, top right).
import.title: Import products
import.warehouseHint: Imported stock quantities are attributed to this warehouse — WooCommerce has no warehouse concept.

overview.emptyBody: Connect a store to start syncing orders and inventory
overview.title: Connected integrations

payment.publishableKeyHint: Optional — required only to offer an embedded card form at checkout instead of a hosted payment link.
payment.registerWebhook: Connected! Register this URL as a webhook endpoint in {{dashboard}}, then paste the signing secret it gives you below.
payment.revolutKeyHint: From your Revolut Business account → Merchant API settings.
payment.stripeKeyHint: From your Stripe Dashboard → Developers → API keys.

postnl.accountHint: Find these in Mijn PostNL zakelijk. Use the customer code for shipments within the EU.
postnl.senderHint: Labels use your company profile address as the sender, unless you set a different one under Shipping addresses.

providerWebhooks.intro: What's actually registered at the provider, pointed at the delivery URL above. Create registers a new subscription for a topic instead of doing it by hand in the provider's own admin UI.
providerWebhooks.title: Provider webhook subscriptions

syncLog.emptyAttention: No syncs need attention — everything's resolved
syncLog.title: Sync History

testMode.intro: While enabled, every outbound WhatsApp message from this connection — replies, order/shipment notifications, automation rules — is redirected to the number below instead of the real customer. Nothing reaches a real customer until you turn this off.
testMode.title: WhatsApp test mode

webhooksShortcut.body: Fan-out rules and every active provider subscription, in one place
webhooksShortcut.title: Webhooks

whatsapp.baseUrlHint: Your own self-hosted Evolution API instance (unofficial WhatsApp gateway) — not an official WhatsApp Business API.
whatsapp.connectedPasteUrl: Connected! Paste this URL into Evolution API's own webhook settings (messages.upsert event) — it's shown only once.

whatsappWebhook.intro: This URL is shown once, at generation time — it isn't stored in a form you can view again. Regenerating replaces the old value immediately: update evolution-go's webhook settings (messages.upsert event) with the new one right after, or inbound messages stop reaching this connection.
whatsappWebhook.title: WhatsApp webhook URL

woo.autoHint: Redirects to your store to approve access. Requires your store to reach this server.
woo.dangerZoneBody: Permanently delete every product this connection has ever imported — variants, SKUs, stock history, images, and any category left empty afterward.
woo.fetchOrderIntro: Import (or update) one known order right now by its WooCommerce order number, without waiting for the next scheduled sync -- useful for backfilling an order you already know is missing.
woo.manualHint: Generate under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
woo.ordersHint: Import only — CommerceOS never pushes orders back to Woo. The first run always does a full import; every run after that is incremental.
woo.reconciliationHint: Re-checks the last 5 days of Woo orders on every run, independent of the Orders schedule above — catches anything that schedule ever missed. Already-imported orders are skipped, so this is safe to run daily.
woo.scheduleIntro: Configure how often each type of data syncs between CommerceOS and this WooCommerce store.
woo.storeDefaultsIntro: WooCommerce's product endpoint doesn't return a currency (it's a store-level setting) — set it once here, reused by both manual imports and the scheduled products/import job. Default location seeds each sync schedule row below until that row picks its own.
woo.backfillPaymentsIntro: Orders imported before they were paid may have no transaction id or paid date. This checks every paid order from this store that is missing them and fills in what WooCommerce has. Only payment details change.
woo.backfillPaymentsNothing: Every paid order already has its payment info.
woo.backfillPaymentsErrors: Some orders could not be checked:
woo.stockReconciliationHint: Compares every linked product’s stock and batch (lot, expiry) in WooCommerce with CommerceOS under the stock rules and pushes only what differs — stock changes already reach Woo the moment they happen. A product deleted in Woo is created again if its sales channel still includes it. Safe to run daily.

wooCategories.empty: No category links yet — push a product to auto-match, or add one below.
wooCategories.intro: A CommerceOS category is auto-matched to a WooCommerce category with the same name the first time a product in it is pushed. Repoint or remove a link, or add one manually for a category that hasn't matched automatically.
wooCategories.title: WooCommerce categories

wooTaxes.empty: No WooCommerce taxes yet — run an import to pull them in, or add one below.
wooTaxes.intro: Every WooCommerce tax class seen on import shows up here, linked to a CommerceOS tax class. Repoint or remove a link, or add one manually for a Woo tax class that hasn't been imported yet.
wooTaxes.title: WooCommerce taxes

wooWebhooks.intro: Generate a secret, then configure it as this webhook's "Secret" when creating it under WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → Webhooks. Regenerating replaces the old value immediately -- update WooCommerce's webhook config with the new one, or deliveries will start failing signature verification.
wooWebhooks.noSecret: No secret generated yet -- webhooks from this connection can't be verified until you generate one.
wooWebhooks.notShownAgain: This won't be shown again -- if you lose it, generate a new one and update WooCommerce.
wooWebhooks.title: Webhook signature secret

moneybird.name: Moneybird
moneybird.tokenHint: Create a personal API token in Moneybird under your user settings (Developers). CommerceOS stores it encrypted.

card.estimateSent: Sent to Moneybird as an estimate.
card.bookedNoMethod: Booked in Moneybird. Payment not registered: the order has no payment method.
card.deleteMessage: It is removed from your books in Moneybird. Afterwards you can send it again, e.g. with the right VAT.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: The Moneybird administration quotes and orders are booked in, and the revenue ledger account their lines go to.
admin.switchWarning: Switching administration clears the ledger account and VAT rates: they belong to one administration.

vat.title: VAT rates
vat.body: The Moneybird tax rate each VAT rate is booked with. A quote or order with a rate that isn't mapped is not sent.

payments.title: Payment methods
payments.body: The Moneybird payment method a paid order's payment is registered with. A paid order with a method that isn't mapped is not sent.
payments.noMethodHint: Orders made by hand have no payment method. Not registering leaves the invoice open in Moneybird, to match from the bank.

auto.title: Auto sync
auto.body: Send quotes and orders to Moneybird as soon as they are created or change. Leave it off if another service already books your orders, and send them by hand from the order or quote page.
auto.label: Send automatically

shippingMoved.text: Shipping provider and addresses are in Settings → Shipping.
